method: ScreenConcept SVG and PNG references are retained as the strict visual family. v0.85.3.3 uses representative QA-only cloze fixtures because the v0.85.3.2 proof fixture was too artificial to prove real sentence integration.
cueDecision: Cue is shown as a small secondary line below the cloze sentence in the existing support/cue slot. This preserves the ScreenConcept sentence zone and prevents under-context cues from pushing the sentence too low.
